CheckTitle: Config (RMS) tracker is enabled for compliance monitoring
Description: Ensure that the Config (Resource Management Service) tracker is enabled to monitor resource configuration compliance across the cloud account.
Risk: Without the Config tracker enabled, there is no automated compliance monitoring of resource configurations. Security misconfigurations may go undetected, increasing the risk of non-compliant resources persisting in the environment.

Code.Other:
1. Log on to the Huawei Cloud console.
2. Navigate to Resource Management Service (RMS).
3. Go to Compliance.
4. Enable the tracker configuration.
5. Configure an agency for RMS to access resources.
6. Click OK.

Recommendation.Text: Enable the Config (RMS) tracker to start monitoring resource configuration compliance.
